name: Forliaukar
backstory: Child of Forliauken and Trezukar; grew up around settles the house's accounts at the market stalls... in Terfila, and knows something of Gorff.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Learned that Farlo has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Trezukar now have a child, Trezukuzco.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Tamuzakar.
Heard that Forliauken and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarla.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Trezukaken.
Heard that Tamuzukar and Forliauken now have a child, Tamuzukauk.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Darnakus 2
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Darnakus 2 slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: makes the walk between Terfila and the crossing when there's nothing better to do at the docks, and lingers by the temple a beat longer than the walk requires.

arc.premise: Forliaukar has stopped waiting on the accounting to be updated and started commissioning a small carved token for the birth himself - something the family can actually hold, not just a line added to a ledger.
